title: A Treatise on the Piercing Qi Needle
summary: A treatise on compressing qi into a hair-thin line so the stiletto point pierces layered cloth and plate rims.

title: The Slim Blade Against Heavier Weapons
summary: A study of how the stiletto-bearer crosses the reach of spears, axes and heavy swords and strikes the arm.

title: Rules for Fighting in Crowded Rooms
summary: Rules for using the narrow blade among tables, posts and pressing bodies where longer weapons cannot swing.

title: Field Manual of the Threaded Point
summary: A field manual for driving the point along one fixed line of qi so the thrust cannot be turned aside.

title: The Twin-Track Needle Discipline
summary: A discipline of the two-track tradition that sends one qi track to guard and one to strike with the stiletto.

title: The Hawk's Stoop Needle Method
summary: A method of high-to-low diving thrusts, taught as the hawk's stoop, where the stiletto falls through a raised guard.

title: Paired Needle Court Treatise
summary: A treatise on matched strokes of the stiletto, paired left and right, so each guard arm is robbed in turn.

title: Wind-Sworn Needle Bearings
summary: A wind-sworn text on taking a bearing against the foe and holding it with the stiletto's point.

title: Needle Work on the Open Plateau
summary: A plateau-bred manual on stiletto work in open ground, reading wind and footing with nothing to hide behind.

title: Gale Bearing Treatise of the Fine Point
